description: This file defines the ComponentViewer class, which manages communication and state for a component in a plugin or extension system. It handles message passing, permissions, item synchronization, and UI interactions within a component-based architecture.

classes.name: ComponentViewer
classes.description: A class that manages component communication, permissions, and item synchronization within a plugin or extension environment.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deallocates the component viewer.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for component events and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: addActionObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for action events and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the component viewer to read-only mode, unless locked.

methods.name: getFeatureStatus
methods.description: Returns the current feature status.

methods.name: shouldRender
methods.description: Determines if the component should be rendered based on current error state.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the current error state if any.

methods.name: handleChangesInItems
methods.description: Handles updates to items, updating component state and sending relevant data through the bridge.

methods.name: sendManyItemsThroughBridge
methods.description: Sends multiple items through the communication bridge with required permissions.

methods.name: sendContextItemThroughBridge
methods.description: Sends a specific context item through the bridge.

methods.name: jsonForItem
methods.description: Serializes an item into a message payload for transmission.

methods.name: contentForItem
methods.description: Extracts content from an item, adding spellcheck info if applicable.

methods.name: replyToMessage
methods.description: Replies to a message with specified data.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message or reply to the component iframe.

methods.name: responseItemsByRemovingPrivateProperties
methods.description: Removes private properties from response items before sending.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the current iframe window.

methods.name: setWindow
methods.description: Sets the iframe window and initializes communication.

methods.name: postActiveThemes
methods.description: Posts active theme URLs to the component.

methods.name: setHidden
methods.description: Hides or unhides the component, triggering updates if unhidden.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Main handler for incoming messages from the component.

methods.name: handleStreamItemsMessage
methods.description: Handles streaming items message, requesting items and sending them.

methods.name: handleStreamContextItemMessage
methods.description: Handles streaming context item message, sending the context item.

methods.name: handleSaveItemsMessage
methods.description: Handles save items message, updating or creating items accordingly.

methods.name: handleCreateItemsMessage
methods.description: Handles create items message, inserting new items.

methods.name: handleDeleteItemsMessage
methods.description: Handles delete items message, confirming and deleting items.

methods.name: handleSetComponentDataMessage
methods.description: Updates component data.

methods.name: handleSetSizeEvent
methods.description: Adjusts iframe size based on message data.

methods.name: getIframe
methods.description: Retrieves the iframe element associated with this component.
